item.title: Ex-counterterrorism chief says Trump must restrain Israel before he can declare victory in Iran
item.summary: Former Counterterrorism Center Director Joe Kent said U.S. President Donald Trump can only claim victory in the Iran war once he has restrained Israel.

item.title: Cruise lines cancel sailings, reroute ships as Middle East conflict disrupts voyages
item.summary: Several cruise lines canceled Middle East voyages amid the Iran conflict, as MSC Cruises chartered flights to repatriate more than 1,500 stranded guests.

item.title: Trump calls on world to build ‘delayed courage,’ seize key oil route from Iran
item.summary: While addressing the nation on Wednesday night, President Donald Trump called on the world's countries to “build up some delayed courage" and “just take" the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Constitution is on Trump’s side in Supreme Court birthright citizenship case
item.summary: A wrong Supreme Court ruling on birthright citizenship could permanently alter American citizenship and entitle children to welfare, the author warns.

item.title: Cardinals' Masyn Winn involved in car crash after delivering game-winning hit vs Mets
item.summary: St. Louis Cardinals shortstop Masyn Winn was involved in a single-car crash hours after he hit a walk-off single against the New York Mets on Wednesday.

item.title: Chinese elites exploiting US birthright citizenship at ‘industrial scale,’ expert warns
item.summary: Author Peter Schweizer says wealthy Chinese nationals are using birthright citizenship at an "industrial scale" to secure U.S. citizenship for their children.

item.title: Carrie Underwood warns Hollywood is a 'self-serving business,' credits faith for keeping her grounded
item.summary: Carrie Underwood says faith keeps her grounded in Hollywood's "self-serving" entertainment industry, opening up about staying true to herself after 20 years in country music.

item.title: Senate passes bill to fund most of DHS after House GOP caves
item.summary: The Senate unanimously approved a bipartisan deal funding most of DHS except ICE and Border Patrol, moving to end the 48-day shutdown standoff.

item.title: Hawaii doctor says wife’s alleged affair sparked violent Maui hike clash — claims she attacked first
item.summary: Hawaii doctor Gerhardt Konig took the stand in his attempted murder trial, testifying he suspected his wife of an affair after finding hidden WhatsApp messages.
